records.subject: Hydrophobic electronically conducting polythiophene phase
records.quote: Two sulfonate-bearing polythiophene systems are studied: a self-made conjugated polyelectrolyte, poly(6-(thiophen-3-yl)hexane-1-sulfonate)-sodium (PTS-Na), and poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene)/poly(styrenesulfonate) (PEDOT/PSS) with different ratios of PEDOT and the polyelectrolyte PSS.
context_quotes: As such, a phase separation between the hydrophobic electronically conducting polythiophene phase and the hydrophilic water-swellable ion-conducting phase is proposed.

records.subject: Humidity increase from dry conditions to approximately 90% RH
records.quote: Two sulfonate-bearing polythiophene systems are studied: a self-made conjugated polyelectrolyte, poly(6-(thiophen-3-yl)hexane-1-sulfonate)-sodium (PTS-Na), and poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene)/poly(styrenesulfonate) (PEDOT/PSS) with different ratios of PEDOT and the polyelectrolyte PSS.
context_quotes: Changing the humidity from dry conditions up to similar to 90% relative humidity results in extremely high water uptakes of more than 90 wt %, which corresponds to similar to 13 water molecules per sulfonate unit at maximum water uptake.
records.conditions: Studied polythiophene films; individual formulation values not specified

records.subject: Water uptake exceeding 90 wt%
records.object: Approximately 13 water molecules per sulfonate unit
records.quote: Changing the humidity from dry conditions up to similar to 90% relative humidity results in extremely high water uptakes of more than 90 wt %, which corresponds to similar to 13 water molecules per sulfonate unit at maximum water uptake.

records.subject: Humidity increase from dry conditions to approximately 90% RH
records.quote: Changing the humidity from dry conditions up to similar to 90% relative humidity results in extremely high water uptakes of more than 90 wt %, which corresponds to similar to 13 water molecules per sulfonate unit at maximum water uptake.
context_quotes: Conversely, the electronic conductivity is less sensitive to increasing humidity, which is due to percolation pathways.
records.conditions: Studied films; electronic conductivity described as less sensitive to increasing humidity

records.subject: Percolation pathways
records.object: Low sensitivity of electronic conductivity to increasing humidity
records.quote: Conversely, the electronic conductivity is less sensitive to increasing humidity, which is due to percolation pathways.

records.subject: Increasing film water content
records.quote: The ionic conductivity strongly increases from 10(-10) S/cm at dry conditions to 10(-3) S/cm at around 30 wt % water content and then levels off at maximum conductivities of 10(-3)-10(-2) S/cm up to water contents of 90 wt %.
records.conditions: 10−10 S/cm when dry; 10−3 S/cm at approximately 30 wt% water; plateau maximum 10−3–10−2 S/cm up to 90 wt% water

records.subject: Mixed conductivity
records.quote: In this contribution, we present our results on the influence of controlled humidity changes on the mixed conductivity and correlation to the concomitant water uptake in the films.
context_quotes: Two sulfonate-bearing polythiophene systems are studied: a self-made conjugated polyelectrolyte, poly(6-(thiophen-3-yl)hexane-1-sulfonate)-sodium (PTS-Na), and poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene)/poly(styrenesulfonate) (PEDOT/PSS) with different ratios of PEDOT and the polyelectrolyte PSS.
records.conditions: Controlled humidity changes in PTS-Na and PEDOT/PSS films; correlation direction unspecified here
